reason: 39 DR1T nutrient predictors and reliable day-one recall selection; no fasting subsample predictor in primary model
scope: Overall six frozen models; calibrated probabilities; diabetes/CVD primary, obesity exploratory. Unweighted comparison on identical participants. No retraining.
variance: Stratified delete-one-PSU jackknife; surviving PSU weights in deleted stratum multiplied by nh/(nh-1). Variance sum_h (nh-1)/nh sum_i (estimate_hi-estimate_full)^2. Student t intervals with PSU-minus-strata degrees of freedom, no finite population correction; intervals untruncated.
limitations: Sensitivity analysis of selected complete-outcome/recall/laboratory cohort; weights do not correct additional analytic selection. Conditional on fitted models. Not Indian validation. Exploratory paired intervals without multiplicity adjustment. Subgroup survey evaluation remains pending.
